CXMT.why: China's largest DRAM maker (DDR5, LPDDR5/5X, LPDDR6 and DDR5 server modules); its revenue moves with the AI-driven DRAM shortage and prices
CXMT.evidence: CXMT 2026 half-year report: China's No. 1 and the world's No. 4 DRAM maker by shipments and sales; H1 2026 revenue +873.64% as the global DRAM shortage lifted prices and volumes

players.product: DDR5 (up to 8000Mbps), LPDDR4X, LPDDR5/5X and LPDDR6 DRAM chips, DDR5 RDIMM / MRDIMM / UDIMM / SODIMM and LPCAMM modules, and DRAM wafers

quarterly_data.signal: CXMT announced on 20 September 2026 at the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention that its 5th-generation process technology platform has entered mass production (it was in customer certification at the half-year report), and showed high-capacity LPDDR5X built on it. Products on the platform have not yet reached scale sales and will not materially affect results in the short term; as a new platform its yield ramp will take time and customer qualification is still required.
